profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, NASA WorldWind
profile.summary:
Seasoned software developer/architect with experience in most mainstream software development technologies.

Platforms: Windows, Mac, Linux, Embedded Linux, IOS, Android
Languages: Java, C#, C++, C, Assembly, SQL, Matlab, Ruby, JavaScript, Objective C
Web Technologies: Java EE, ASP.NET, Rails, Web Services, HTML5
Databases: MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL
Application Servers: IIS, WebSphere, WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss
Other expertise: Agile development, Git/GitHub, GIS, UAV, Crop Science, performance tuning, large data processing, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS).

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Server and client side development of geospatial SDKs for the NASA WorldWind Earth Science project. Designed and developed algorithms for serving and visualization of 3D geospatial data in Java, JavaScript and C++ for Linux, Android, and HTML5 platforms.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Led the technical design and development of several software systems for use in UAV control/data processing and crop science. Client and server side development in Matlab, Java, HTML, Javascript, MySQL, and MS SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Architect/Consultant
positions.description: Client and server side development in .NET/MS SQL Server and Ruby on Rails/MySQL.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Server side development in .NET/MS SQL Server, specification and design of system features. Embedded programming in C++ of Linux based meter monitors. Led a team of 5 people.

positions.title: Technical Product Manager/Contractor
positions.description: Led the technical design, architecture, and development of the RightNow Connect Integration product. Duties included project planning, technical design, C#/Java development, and MySQL database development on Linux and Windows platforms.

positions.title: Various roles
positions.description: Various software development and management roles.
